content.rendered:
The Sherwood School District Board of Directors will meet in a Work Session and Regular Meeting on Wednesday, December 9, 2020. To access a livestream video of this meeting, please visit the District’s YouTube channel at https://bit.ly/39VlhD3

  • 5:15pm – Budget Committee Interviews (Virtual Meeting – Non-Public)
  • 5:45pm – Work Session (Virtual Meeting – Live Stream)
  • 7:00pm – Regular Meeting (Virtual Meeting – Live Stream)

The agenda for the meeting can be found here.

To submit public comment, please use form found here. Public comment will be read during the meeting by the Board Secretary, up to three minutes per comment (as per time limit indicated on meeting agenda).
